_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform. The ✳️any subset registers `lopdf` under `pdf-1-7-mutate` for the DOCUMENT vocabulary; this file registers the same package under a distinct id and the `pdf-1-7-a-mutate` capability the CONFORMANCE-CLASS case (`mutate-pdf-1-7-a`) tags, because reusing a neighbour's entry fails the contract with `oracle-capability-mismatch`.

oracles.rationale: `lopdf` parses and re-serializes the complete COS object graph of a real PDF, which is the exact surface ISO 19005-2 / ISO 19005-3 (PDF/A-2, PDF/A-3) conformance is defined on: every axis `check_pdf_a_conformance` reads is an indirect object, a catalog key or a dictionary entry, and every one of them is reachable and writable through this crate. It is registered under its own id and capability so this subset's 14-kind conformance catalog is measured against a reference surveyed for that capability rather than borrowing the ✳️any subset's document-vocabulary entry.

comparisonProfiles.description: A PDF document compared by the CONFORMANCE-CLASS surface check_pdf_a_conformance actually reads, every field read back out of the bytes by the independent `lopdf` object-graph reader: the page count as a stability anchor, plus every Standard Security Handler dictionary object, by its /V and /R; every /S /JavaScript action, by the script its /JS carries; every /S /Launch action, by the target its /F carries; every /Type /Filespec, by file name, whether it carries an /EF attached stream, and its /AFRelationship; every intent reachable from /Root/OutputIntents, by /S marker, output condition identifier and whether it carries a /DestOutputProfile; every /Type /FontDescriptor in object-number order, by which of /FontFile, /FontFile2 or /FontFile3 carries its embedded program, how many bytes that program is once its stream filters are DECODED, and a digest of those decoded bytes. Page CONTENT is deliberately absent — media boxes, content streams and shown text belong to the ✳️any subset's own semantic-pdf-v1 profile, and a conformance class says nothing about them. Object NUMBERS are deliberately absent too: a class is defined on what the document contains, not on where a writer put it, so re-inserting a removed construct at a fresh number is a faithful undo and recording the number would report a false divergence for it. An embedded font program is measured DECODED and never by the length of the stream that stores it: /FontFile, /FontFile2 and /FontFile3 streams are almost always /FlateDecode, and deflate output length is ENCODER FREEDOM — two conformant writers may compress a byte-identical program to byte counts that differ by a byte or two, which is precisely what the first full differential run of these six classes measured (all 23 embedded programs of the real thesis decoded byte-identically while five of their stored streams differed by 1–2 bytes). The ✳️any subset's semantic-pdf-v1 profile already takes that reading, listing streamLength as writer freedom. Decoding is not a relaxation: the decoded length plus a digest of the decoded bytes is a STRICTER axis than the stored length ever was, because a program whose bytes change is now caught even when its length does not. The only numeric fields are the encryption /V and /R, an embedded font program's decoded byte length and the page-box coordinates, all of them exact integers or literal coordinates a writer must reproduce exactly; hence no tolerance.
